brief:
Prisoner advocacy organizations hold the Israeli occupation fully responsible for the fate of detained journalist Bashira al-Tawil from Ramallah, Shehab Wire reported. Al-Tawil has been held in solitary confinement in Nevi Tertsa prison for approximately one month, according to the groups.

The organizations said al-Tawil was transferred to the facility under undisclosed circumstances. Her prolonged isolation has prompted the groups to issue statements demanding accountability from Israeli authorities.

title: Prisoner groups hold Israel responsible for journalist Bashira al-Tawil's fate
